<translate>
<!--T:5-->
'''Medi-Bugs''' are edible bugs from the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm|Demon Realm]]. Each kind has a different effect: the Ant heals, the Rhino hardens your body, the Worm speeds up form mastery and the Beetle pair lets two players fuse.
</translate>

<translate>
== Types == <!--T:6-->
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:7--> Medi-Bug</translate> !! <translate><!--T:8--> Effect when eaten</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:9--> Medi-Bug (Ant)</translate> || <translate><!--T:10--> Restores '''85%''' of your health, ki and stamina. It has its own cooldown, the same length as the Senzu Bean's (12 seconds by default).</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:11--> Medi-Bug (Rhino)</translate> || <translate><!--T:12--> Gives the '''Medi-Bug Shell''' effect for '''45 seconds''': you take 30% less damage.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:13--> Medi-Bug (Worm)</translate> || <translate><!--T:14--> Gives '''Mastery Multiplier II''' for '''5 minutes''': 50% more form mastery gain.</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:15--> Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate><!--T:16--> Right-click it to split it into two '''Medi-Bug (Beetle)''' with the same ID. Two players who eat beetles with the same ID within 30 seconds of each other '''fuse''' (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Medi-Bug Beetles|Medi-Bug Beetles]]).</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Getting Medi-Bugs == <!--T:17-->

<!--T:18-->
About 40% of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Demon Realm Villager|Demon Realm Villagers]] are bug traders. Each sells 2 or 3 of these for emeralds:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"
! <translate><!--T:19--> Medi-Bug</translate> !! <translate><!--T:20--> Cost</translate> !! <translate><!--T:21--> Uses</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:22--> Medi-Bug (Ant)</translate> || <translate><!--T:23--> 8 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate><!--T:24--> Pair of Medi-Bugs (Beetle)</translate> || <translate><!--T:25--> 16 Emeralds</translate> || 2
|-
| <translate><!--T:26--> Medi-Bug (Rhino)</translate> || <translate><!--T:27--> 6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|-
| <translate><!--T:28--> Medi-Bug (Worm)</translate> || <translate><!--T:29--> 6 Emeralds</translate> || 6
|}
<translate>
<!--T:30-->
Trades restock once per in-game day.

<!--T:31-->
Bulma's repeatable '''Medi-Bug Market''' sidequest also sells a batch of Medi-Bugs, a Beetle pair included, for emeralds and gold ingots, once an hour. The [[Special:MyLanguage/Gomah's Army|Gomah's Army]] raid rewards 4 Medi-Bugs (Ant).
</translate>
